source_code: import java.io.*;import java.util.*;public class codeforces452C{public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException{StringTokenizer st=new StringTokenizer(new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in)).readLine());double N=Double.parseDouble(st.nextToken()),M=Double.parseDouble(st.nextToken());System.out.printf("%.12f\n",(N==1&&M==1) ? 1.0 : ((1/N)+((M-1)*(N-1))/(N*(N*M-1))));}}
